messages:
kim: Quick heads-up — planning to run an additive partial index on events (events_type_idx_partial) at 00:30 UTC tonight in the DB change window. In staging this dropped query p99 from ~2.5s to ~200ms. Tagging @raj @sophie for app pin and rollback plan.

deploy-bot: @kim claimed change window 00:30-01:30 UTC for migration 'events-partial-index' (id: mig-2026-04-02-01). Please post final go/no-go 15m before start. :white_check_mark:

raj: Thanks. Do we need to pin the API to avoid using the new index early? Which release tag should we pin to?

kim: Good call. The index is additive, but the app has a planner hint that could start preferring the index for a subset of queries. Plan: pin app to v2.14.1 for the duration of the window and flip to v2.14.2 after we validate post-migration.

sophie: Also recommend gating via feature flag `use_events_partial_idx` — keep OFF during migration, then enable after verification. That gives us safe rollback without code revert.

miguel: Can you drop the SQL and rollback steps here? I want to stage the runbook tasks for infra.

kim: SQL for create + rollback below. We'll use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY to avoid heavy locks. Note: running CONCURRENTLY requires no conflicting transactions, so ensure no open long-lived tx in writers during the op.

```sql
-- create (non-blocking)
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS events_type_idx_partial
ON public.events (type)
WHERE processed = true;

-- verification: ensure index is valid
-- rollback (drop index) if we abort
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS events_type_idx_partial;
```

kim: Preflight checklist:
- confirm app pinned to v2.14.1 (raj)
- feature flag `use_events_partial_idx` set to OFF (sophie)
- no long-lived transactions (miguel) — run `SELECT * FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' AND query_start < now() - interval '5 minutes';`
- staging run completed and explain plans attached (passed)
- ops monitor: lock_waits, p99 write latency, replica_lag, index creation progress (pg_stat_progress_create_index)

raj: I can pin the release. Will push a one-minute preflight at 00:14 UTC and confirm pinned.

sophie: Feature flag ready. I'll flip to OFF now and won't toggle until you give the green.

miguel: I'll kick off TX scan at T-5 and coordinate with oncall. Also prepared a kill + cleanup snippet in case create stalls: 

```bash
-- find and cancel the index build backend pid
psql -c "SELECT pid, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY%' AND state = 'active';"
-- then
psql -c "SELECT pg_cancel_backend(<pid>);"
-- if broken, DROP INDEX may be needed once safe
psql -c "DROP INDEX IF EXISTS events_type_idx_partial;"
```

oncall-sre-bot: Alerting run: migrations-alerts will watch for >30s index progress stalls and replica lag > 10s. Will page if thresholds breach.

kim: 00:15 preflight: all green from my side. Staging plan carried over. Going to start at 00:30 with CONCURRENTLY. Last chance for objections.

raj: Pinned app to v2.14.1 at 00:18 UTC. Verified traffic routed to pinned instances.

sophie: Flag OFF confirmed at 00:20 UTC.

miguel: No long-lived tx found at 00:22 UTC. Replica lag 0-2s. Ready to proceed.

deploy-bot: Starting migration job mig-2026-04-02-01 at 00:30:10 UTC. Logs: /deploys/mig-2026-04-02-01/logs

kim: Starting CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY now. Monitoring pg_stat_progress_create_index and lock_waits.

miguel: Noting small spike in io, expected. pg_stat_progress_create_index shows 8% at 00:31.

raj: App metrics show no change in write p99. Good so far.

oncall-sre-bot: Alert check 00:35: index progress steady, replica lag within threshold. No pages.

kim: At 00:40 index build reached 100% and state is valid. Running quick explain on a few representative queries.

sophie: Explain shows new index not used while flag is OFF — perfect.

raj: Flipping app to v2.14.2 at 00:42 UTC (canary subset 5% first).

miguel: Watching error rates. Canary good for 5 minutes.

raj: Rolling v2.14.2 to 50% at 00:47, then full at 00:50 after no regressions.

sophie: Flipping feature flag `use_events_partial_idx` ON at 00:51 for canary. No issues.

kim: Post-mortem notes for runbook:
- Duration: index created in ~10 minutes by CONCURRENTLY.
- Monitoring keys: no lock spikes, replica lag < 5s, no errors.
- Rollback path if we saw regressions: stop rollout, flip flag OFF, revert app to v2.14.1, optionally DROP INDEX IF EXISTS events_type_idx_partial if we decide index must be removed (coord with DB team).

miguel: One follow-up: schedule reindex maintenance to compact the index in 2 weeks. Also add a telemetry tag so we can track key queries using the index.

raj: Confirming release notes: 'Added partial index events_type_idx_partial to speed up processed events queries. Rolled out with feature flag and staged app upgrade. No user-visible changes.' I'll merge to release notes doc.

kim: Great run. Closing migration job and unclaiming window. Thanks team :tada:
